Case taken up before the Lawazima Court.
None appears on behalf of the petitioner.

Perusal of the instant case record reveals that the earlier Lawazima Court vide its order dated 11.03.2025 had granted 7 (seven) days time to obtain necessary instructions regarding the address of respondent No. 5.

Thereafter, it has been observed that the instant matter was listed again before the Lawazima Court on 27.05.2025 and the said Lawazima Court was pleased to grant the petitioner one last chance to take necessary steps for obtaining instructions regarding the address of respondent No. 5.
However, no one has appeared on behalf of the petitioner before the Lawazima Court today to make submission regarding the address of the respondent mentioned above.
In view of the observations made above, it may be discerned that the petitioner may not be interested to pursue the case.
As such, the matter is laid before the Hon'ble Court.
